definitions.gloss: aromatic garnish added to clear soup
definitions.explanation: A small fragrant garnish, such as {木|き}の{芽|め} (young sansho leaves), {柚子|ゆず} peel, or {三|み}つ{葉|ば}, floated on top of {吸|す}い{物|もの} (clear soup) just before serving to add aroma.

examples.japanese: {吸|す}い{口|くち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{柚子|ゆず}→柚子：13102_yuzu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used yuzu peel as the aromatic garnish.
Sansho leaves go well as the aromatic garnish for clear soup.

examples.japanese: {吸|す}い{口|くち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{添|そ}えるだけで、⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧がぐっと⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}つ→引き立つ：25243_hikitatsu⟧。
examples.english: Just adding the aromatic garnish makes the aroma stand out much more.

notes:
{吸|す}い{口|くち} is the small fragrant garnish floated on ⟦{吸|す}い{物|もの}→吸い物：04990_suimono⟧ (clear soup) right before serving, distinct from the ⟦{椀種|わんだね}→椀種：30943_wandane⟧ (main ingredient).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{木|き}の{芽|め}→木の芽：30945_kinome⟧: young sansho leaves
- ⟦{柚子|ゆず}→柚子：13102_yuzu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: yuzu peel
- ⟦{三|み}つ{葉|ば}→三つ葉：11242_mitsuba⟧: mitsuba (Japanese wild parsley)
- {粉山椒|こなざんしょう}: ground sansho pepper

USAGE:
Outside cooking, {吸|す}い{口|くち} can also mean the mouthpiece of a pipe or cigarette, or a drain outlet — the shared idea being a small opening or point of contact where something is drawn in.
